searchText: Any clients have any new branches/updates to their existing branches that I should be rolling out? We are still at around 50% participation. Will have a new version today that will, hopefully: - Fix (or more precisely, workaround) the discv5 issue with Prysm when there is Grandine in the peers - Fix the issue Prysm has regarding initial synchronization ==> Hopefully, Prysm should be green again at the end of the day we are adding API similar to blobsidecars to Teku, I think it's straightforward is checkpoint sync working? I'm gettting this ``` java.io.FileNotFoundException: File 'https://checkpoint-sync.peerdas-devnet-2.ethpandaops.io/eth/v1/beacon/deposit_snapshot' not found ``` Is there a way to directly access the beacon API of a beacon node in the devnet? There is https://beacon.peerdas-devnet-2.ethpandaops.io/, but it is a load-balancing proxy. I see in Ethereum node inventory `beacon_uri` such as https://rpc.lighthouse-geth-1.peerdas-devnet-2.ethpandaops.io, but it requires credentials. (cc <@412614104222531604> )
